title: Durable OTHRYS Work objects
goal: Establish durable project-local Work records and evidence transition history over canonical V2 Missions without creating a second execution engine.

work.problem: OTHRYS has governed Mission execution but needs a durable Panda-class Work object for structured project orchestration and resume.
risks: Dual truth if Work state can override Mission evidence
False completion if transition history is not evidence-bound

laws: Canonical Mission/result/receipt evidence wins over Work projection.
Work transitions are observations, not authority grants.
Stable work/slice/stage/task identities must survive resume.
Transition history is append-only and content-bound.

tasks.title: Compile deterministic Work object from Mission definition
Verify identity, authority-free state and tamper handling
Derive transition observation from canonical Work projection
